_about: Real mattermost/mattermost commits that were later reverted (cases) and size-matched clean commits from the same directory (controls). Run with: scripts/eval_reverts.py eval/revert_cases.json --repo <clone of mattermost/mattermost with history back to 2023-06> --dispatch '<cmd>'. Each `bug` is quoted from the revert PR named in `source`; hunters never see it. Controls: the non-merge commit within 90 days of the case, in the same directory, with 0.5x-2x its non-test source files and changed lines (closest match), never reverted, and sharing no MM- ticket with the case. The thresholds are starting targets, not measurements: calibrate them after the first full run.
